name: Dachshund – Short Legs, Long Opinions
title: Dachshund – Short Legs, Long Opinions Mug
story: This dachshund mug is for the owner of a small dog with big feelings: a wide-eyed red-spotted wiener dog mid-bark, with SHORT LEGS, above and LONG OPINIONS below. It is an easy Christmas morning coffee gift, stocking stuffer or secret Santa pick for anyone whose dachshund has an opinion about dinner, the mailman and where you are allowed to sit.

The print is a bold retro illustration in red, gold and cream: a long-bodied dachshund with spotted fur, floppy ears, big round eyes and an open mouth in full complaint. The words are set in heavy dark red slab capitals, big enough to read from across the kitchen table, and the whole design sits on bright white glossy ceramic, on both sides of the mug.

Dachshund people laugh because they live with it: a dog built close to the ground that never stops sharing its views. Pour in coffee, tea or cocoa and let the doxie do the talking. It makes a good gift for a mom, dad, grandparent or coworker who has a wiener dog photo on their desk and a squeaky toy in every room.

The mug matches our Short Legs, Long Opinions hoodie, so the mug and the hoodie make a funny set for the same dachshund lover. Every mug is printed to order by Graphic Tees Co., so the design arrives crisp and ready to give.
joke_a: A dachshund has short legs and very long opinions, and this one is barking all of them. The Short Legs, Long Opinions mug from Graphic Tees Co. shows a spotted wiener dog in mid-complaint, so any dachshund owner who has been lectured over dinner sees the joke with each sip of coffee.
